en: Vintage, monochrome postcard view over the Danube river towards a riverside square with grand late‑19th‑century buildings and a tram line. The caption at the top in red ink identifies the scene as Gellért Square with the Technical University in Budapest, presented in both Hungarian and German. The layout and printing style suggest an early 20th‑century European cityscape postcard.
